items.title: Nouveau trou d'air pour Kering apres une conference de fin de trimestre frileuse
items.summary: Kering shares fell 2.7% (CAC 40's second-worst performer that session) after a pre-close investor call in which management struck a cautious tone, citing a tougher summer, continued weakness in China and slowing momentum in the US, Japan and South Korea ahead of Q3 results.

items.title: HSBC reduit son objectif sur Gucci, mais conseille toujours d'acheter
items.summary: HSBC cut its Kering price target from 305 to 300 euros, flagging a slowdown in new product launches versus Q2 and store-traffic deterioration despite better conversion, while still defending Gucci's 'higher quality, pricing discipline' repositioning under Demna; Citi, Jefferies and Barclays made larger cuts the same day on a gloomier Q3 outlook (Gucci sales now seen down 6%, not 3.5%).

items.title: Gucci Beauty Holiday 2026 Limited-Edition Collection launches
items.summary: Gucci Beauty's holiday 2026 makeup range (two Blush De Beaute shades, three matte lipsticks, one gloss, priced $42-$49) went on sale October 3 at Gucci.com, Selfridges, Sephora, Nordstrom, Saks and other retailers, continuing the brand's push into mass-accessible beauty as a growth lever outside core leather goods.

items.title: Gucci Spring 2027 Ready-to-Wear Runway review
items.summary: WWD's runway review of Demna's third Gucci womenswear outing frames the collection as the designer's fullest personal statement yet for the house, mixing preppy codes with Gothic tailoring and 1990s Gucci sex appeal, while noting the retail-staged 'Store Show' format drew as much commentary as the clothes themselves.

items.title: 'China has arrived': from $1,000 Gucci sneakers to German cars
items.summary: Fortune uses Gucci's decision to make its new Drip sneaker in China as the lead example of a 'second China shock,' arguing Chinese manufacturers have moved from cheap labor to genuine technical competitiveness, eroding the premium that justified European luxury and industrial pricing at the middle-to-top of the market.

items.title: Forum members review the 'vulgar' Gucci Spring 2027 collection from Demna
items.summary: Fashion-forum commenters were overwhelmingly negative on Demna's Spring 2027 womenswear, calling it 'a tragedy,' 'pure vulgarity, paired with an absolute lack of vision' and 'a pile of nothingness,' with several predicting the collection could mark the start of his final season at Gucci.

items.title: French consumer reviews rate Gucci.com 1.9/5
items.summary: French-language Trustpilot reviews continue to score Gucci's e-commerce experience poorly (1.9/5 across recent authenticated reviews), with recurring complaints about product quality not matching price (a 400-euro shawl pilling within a month) and unresponsive customer service.

items.source: X (Twitter), aggregated via Esquire Australia menswear roundup
items.title: Esquire Australia October menswear roundup flags Gucci Spring 2027 tailoring
items.summary: Esquire's bite-sized October menswear news roundup highlights Gucci Spring 2027's 'preppy styling's dark side' as one of the month's notable runway stories, citing social commentary split between praise for Demna's sharper tailoring direction and skepticism that it is enough to shift the brand's commercial trajectory.

items.title: Gucci lascia Roma per Milano, ira dei lavoratori: "Licenziamenti mascherati"
items.summary: Roughly 40 Gucci style-office employees staged a strike and sit-in in Rome protesting the transfer of 153 of 219 Rome-based roles to Milan by March 1; unions call it a 'masked collective layoff' while Gucci maintains the move involves no headcount reduction and complies with labor law.
